profile.description: Based on Deepseek-V3.2 with extended file processing capabilities. This multimodal bot accepts XLSX, PY, HTM, HTML, CSS, JS, CSV, DOCX, JSON, PY, JPG, PNG, BMP, WEBP, TXT and PDF files. DeepSeek-V3.2 can also create apps inside the chat. DeepSeek-V3.2-OSL can't process file like STL, XLS, WEBM, MP4, MP3, WAV, ODS, HEIC, GIF and AVIF images. Maximum file size is 50 MB.
